head: LXY0925lxy:fix/dual-h1-headers
title: fix: fix dual H1 headers in README docs
body:
Fix multiple README files that have two consecutive H1 (#) headers, which violates Markdown best practice of having only one H1 per document.

Changes:
- button_control_vehicle/README.md: merge dual H1 into single H1
- carla_slam_gmapping/README.md: merge dual H1 into single H1
- humanoid_mujoco_py/README.md: merge dual H1 into single H1
- mujoco01/README.md: merge dual H1 with correct module name
- carla_multi_tracking/README.md: merge CN/EN dual H1 into bilingual title
